details: This package is a WhatsApp Web API library distributed under a different scope from the upstream project, and it contains owner-imposed controls that are not documented to the installer. When a socket is created, lib/Socket/socket.js runs an "IP PROTECTION SYSTEM" check: it requests the host's public IP from hxxps://api[.]ipify[.]org/?format=json and calls process.exit(1) unless the address equals the hard-coded 20[.]207[.]192[.]84 (it also exits when the lookup fails), so the library kills the consuming process on any other machine. On every successful WhatsApp connection, lib/Socket/newsletter.js silently subscribes the user's own account to the hard-coded channel 120363410154606795@newsletter (newsletter w:mex FOLLOW query) without asking the user. The bundled scraper helpers in lib/Utils/youtube.js, Tiktok.js, instagram.js and facebook.js send caller-supplied URLs through third-party scraping services, e.g. hxxps://api[.]fruatre[.]my[.]id/api/ytplay. No credential, token, environment or file exfiltration was found; there are no install lifecycle hooks.
